tooling.message:
docs(site): render the workshop page from the building blocks

## Intent

The workshop page was hand-written, so it could drift from the architecture it shows. Render it from the modelled building blocks instead. arc42 cannot yet carry a block's phase as a custom attribute, so an explicit mapping comes first.

## Key changes

- The page is rendered at build time from an explicit mapping: per phase the blocks of docs/arc42 that support it, with a short text each, and their titles from arc42 get.
- The build fails when the mapping names a block the model lacks, or when the skills of a phase differ from the skill blocks under bb-skills-<phase>. Tests cover both.
- The page looks as before.
- Once arc42 carries custom attributes, the mapping can shrink to the page's texts.

tooling.reason: A separate concern: clearing the architecture warnings before the merge.
tooling.message:
docs(arc42): the process guidance implements the rule catalog

## Intent

The architecture review of the pull request warned that two blocks changed their text but not their model. The process guidance holds the workflow rules with their ids, as chapter 8 says, so the model should say it too.

## Key changes

- bb-process-guidance implements concept-rule-catalog. arc42 diff against main reports nothing.

apps.reason: Two test fixes on the branch of apps#62 that follow each other directly.
apps.message:
test(entry-point): follow the tooling's grouped skill folders and compact plan template

## Intent

The tests of the platform's entry point failed against the reworked tooling: they expected the old skill paths and the old wording of the plan template. They must follow the new layout so apps#62 can merge.

## Key changes

- The tests expect the tooling's skills in their grouped folders.
- The test that reads where the plan is kept also understands the compact template ("Path: .vibe/plans/01-<short name>.md").

## Dependencies and side effects

- The link tests pass only once tooling#118 is on main.
